name: Plan and Build
description: Planning and then building something substantial: understand the requirement and the starting point, design the approach, then build and verify one component at a time. For any feature, project or multi-step piece of work that benefits from planning before execution.
narrative: Planning and building go best in a rhythm. First understand the requirement and the starting point: read what exists, and read the relevant skills before you touch a tool. Then design the approach, and when the work is consequential, show the design and get it approved before building. Build one component at a time, never the whole thing at once: verify each and commit it before starting the next, and report what remains. Small, verified steps beat one big change that has to be debugged all at once.
